I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I noted that the Tansley Parcel signed order form is due 25 August.

I also pointed out a likely problem with the date. The simulation clock says it's 14 October 2026, so 25 August this year has already passed. I asked whether they meant next August or a different date.

The deadline is only noted in that thread reply. I didn't make a calendar entry or save it anywhere else. I didn't need any approval, because a signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
